pages.title: Eastern Grey Kangaroo
pages.text: The eastern grey kangaroo ($(o)Macropus giganteus$()) lives in the open forests and grasslands of eastern Australia and Tasmania.$(br2)It has a soft grey-brown coat and lives in groups called mobs, grazing mostly at dawn, dusk and night.$(br2)It is one of the fastest kangaroos, reaching over 60 km/h in short bursts.
